title: Continue
subtitle: 繼續，究竟是哪一種「持續下去」？
description: 繼續，究竟是哪一種「持續下去」？

words.note: 非常常見的近義片語，表示不中斷地繼續做正在進行的事。
words.example: Despite the noise, she carried on working.
words.exampleZh: 儘管很吵，她仍繼續工作。

exercises.original: Despite the noise, she continued working on the report.
exercises.zh: 儘管很吵，她仍繼續撰寫報告。
exercises.upgrade: carry on · 繼續；繼續進行

options.explanation: paused = paused 表示暫停，和仍然工作相反。
repeated = 她不是把報告重新做一次。
carry on = despite the noise 表示她沒有因干擾停止，因此 carried on working 最自然。
resumed = resumed 暗示之前曾停下來，本句沒有中斷線索。

exercises.original: The teacher continued explaining even after the bell rang.
exercises.zh: 鐘聲響起後，老師仍繼續解釋。
exercises.upgrade: carry on · 繼續；繼續進行

options.explanation: restarted = 沒有先停止再重啟。
carry on = even after the bell rang 強調本來可能停下，但老師仍不中斷地做下去，因此 carried on 很貼切。
finished = bell 響後仍在說明，顯然未結束。

exercises.original: He continued talking as if nothing had happened.
exercises.zh: 他像甚麼也沒發生一樣繼續說話。
exercises.upgrade: carry on · 繼續；繼續進行

options.explanation: paused = 和 as if nothing had happened 的持續感相反。
repeated = 不表示同一談話持續。
carry on = 談話沒有被事件打斷，較口語地說 carried on talking 最自然。

words.note: 較口語，強調不要停止、繼續前進或繼續努力。
words.example: We were tired, but we decided to keep going.
words.exampleZh: 我們很累，但仍決定繼續下去。

exercises.original: We were exhausted, but we decided to continue.
exercises.zh: 我們筋疲力盡，但仍決定繼續下去。
exercises.upgrade: keep going · 繼續下去；不要停

options.explanation: stop = 和 but 後的決定相反。
keep going = exhausted, but 突出即使疲累仍不停止，因此口語 keep going 最貼切。
finish = 句子未說已到終點。
pause = 不是休息，而是繼續。

exercises.original: If you continue for another kilometre, you will reach the village.
exercises.zh: 如果你再繼續走一公里，就會到達村莊。
exercises.upgrade: keep going · 繼續下去；不要停

options.explanation: turn back = 表示折返，方向相反。
keep going = 這裡是實際前進路程，keep going 很自然地表示再走下去。
finish = 還要再走一公里才到。

exercises.original: The coach told the runners to continue even when they felt tired.
exercises.zh: 教練叫跑手即使累了也要繼續。
exercises.upgrade: keep going · 繼續下去；不要停

options.explanation: slow down = 可能是策略，但不是繼續本身。
finish = 教練是在過程中鼓勵，而不是說已完成。
keep going = 跑手疲累時教練鼓勵不要停，固定口語就是 keep going。

words.note: 常見口語表達，表示某個動作、活動或情況繼續發生。
words.example: The meeting went on for another hour.
words.exampleZh: 會議又繼續了一個小時。

exercises.original: The meeting continued for another hour.
exercises.zh: 會議又繼續了一個小時。
exercises.upgrade: go on · 繼續；接著做

options.explanation: finished = 如果 finished，就不會 another hour。
go on = for another hour 表示活動繼續持續，因此 went on 最自然。
resumed = 本句沒有中斷後恢復的線索。

exercises.original: The rain continued throughout the night.
exercises.zh: 雨整晚持續不停。
exercises.upgrade: go on · 繼續；接著做

options.explanation: stopped = 和 throughout the night 相反。
repeated = 雨不是重複一次動作。
began = 只表示開始，不能涵蓋整晚。
go on = throughout the night 強調情況持續，went on 可自然表達長時間繼續。

exercises.original: She continued talking about the same topic for several minutes.
exercises.zh: 她繼續談同一話題數分鐘。
exercises.upgrade: go on · 繼續；接著做

options.explanation: go on = went on talking 是常見片語，表示談話繼續一段時間。
completed = 談話不能這樣說 completed topic。
repeated = 雖是同一 topic，但不是重複同一句話。

words.note: 較正式，表示按照計劃或程序繼續下一步。
words.example: After the safety check, the team proceeded with the test.
words.exampleZh: 完成安全檢查後，團隊繼續進行測試。

exercises.original: After the safety check, the team continued with the test.
exercises.zh: 完成安全檢查後，團隊繼續進行測試。
exercises.upgrade: proceed · 繼續進行；進一步進行

options.explanation: paused = 安全檢查完成後並不是停下。
started over = 沒有從頭再來。
persisted = persisted with 可表示堅持，但程序語境不如 proceeded 正式自然。
proceed = after the safety check 表示完成一個程序後進入下一步，因此 proceeded with 最精確。

exercises.original: Once approval was received, construction continued as planned.
exercises.zh: 獲得批准後，工程按計劃繼續。
exercises.upgrade: proceed · 繼續進行；進一步進行

options.explanation: proceed = approval 是繼續下一階段的正式條件，因此 proceeded as planned 很自然。
remained = 不能說 construction remained as planned 來表達繼續施工。

exercises.original: The court allowed the case to continue to trial.
exercises.zh: 法院允許案件繼續進入審訊。
exercises.upgrade: proceed · 繼續進行；進一步進行

options.explanation: proceed = to trial 表示法律程序進入下一階段，正式用語 proceed to trial 最準確。
pause = 法院不是叫它暫停。
persist = 案件本身不自然說 persist to trial。

words.note: 表示某個行為、狀況或問題持續存在，或某人即使遇到困難仍繼續。
words.example: If the symptoms persist, contact your doctor.
words.exampleZh: 如果症狀持續，請聯絡醫生。

exercises.original: If the symptoms continue for more than three days, contact a doctor.
exercises.zh: 如果症狀持續超過三天，請聯絡醫生。
exercises.upgrade: persist · 持續；堅持

options.explanation: persist = 症狀在一段時間內仍然存在，醫療語境最自然用 persist。
repeat = 症狀持續存在不等於重複一次。
restart = 沒有先消失再出現。
proceed = proceed 用於程序或行動，不適合 symptoms。

exercises.original: The problem continued despite several attempts to fix it.
exercises.zh: 儘管多次嘗試修理，問題仍然持續。
exercises.upgrade: persist · 持續；堅持

options.explanation: ended = 和 despite several attempts 相反。
persist = despite several attempts to fix it 表示問題一直沒有消失，因此 persisted 最精確。
resumed = 沒有問題曾消失的意思。
repeated = 不是某動作被重做。

exercises.original: Heavy fog continued into the afternoon.
exercises.zh: 濃霧持續至下午。
exercises.upgrade: persist · 持續；堅持

options.explanation: paused = 天氣狀況不會以此表示短暫停止。
restarted = 沒有消散後再出現。
persist = 濃霧長時間保持存在，persisted into the afternoon 是自然搭配。

words.note: 強調遇到困難、失敗或阻力時仍不放棄。
words.example: She persevered despite several early setbacks.
words.exampleZh: 儘管早期遇到幾次挫折，她仍堅持下去。

exercises.original: She continued despite several early failures.
exercises.zh: 儘管早期有幾次失敗，她仍堅持下去。
exercises.upgrade: persevere · 堅持不懈；繼續努力

options.explanation: persevere = despite several early failures 明確突出困難下仍不放棄，因此 persevered 最準確。
quit = 和 despite failures 相反。
repeated = 失敗後繼續努力不等於重複同一動作。
proceeded = 可表示繼續，但不能突出克服失敗的毅力。

exercises.original: The researchers continued even when the first experiments produced no useful results.
exercises.zh: 即使最初實驗沒有有用結果，研究人員仍堅持下去。
exercises.upgrade: persevere · 堅持不懈；繼續努力

options.explanation: finished = 沒有結果仍不是結束。
persevere = 在沒有成果的情況下仍繼續研究，重點是毅力，因此 persevered 最貼切。
repeated = 可能會重複實驗，但本句重點是沒有放棄整個研究。
remained = 不能單獨替代動作。

exercises.original: He continued with his training through months of slow progress.
exercises.zh: 儘管幾個月進展緩慢，他仍堅持訓練。
exercises.upgrade: persevere · 堅持不懈；繼續努力

options.explanation: persevere = months of slow progress 是長期困難，persevered with his training 最能表達不放棄。
proceeded = 可用但不突出 months of slow progress 下的堅持。

words.note: 較有力度的表達，表示即使困難或疲累仍繼續前進。
words.example: The hikers pressed on despite the worsening weather.
words.exampleZh: 儘管天氣惡化，行山人士仍繼續前進。

exercises.original: Despite the worsening weather, the hikers continued toward the village.
exercises.zh: 儘管天氣惡化，行山人士仍繼續向村莊前進。
exercises.upgrade: press on · 繼續前進；堅持做下去

options.explanation: turned back = 和 toward the village 的繼續前進相反。
press on = worsening weather 下仍向目的地前進，pressed on 能突出困難中繼續。
remained = 表示留在原地，與前進相反。

exercises.original: The team continued with the rescue operation despite the darkness.
exercises.zh: 儘管天色昏暗，團隊仍繼續救援行動。
exercises.upgrade: press on · 繼續前進；堅持做下去

options.explanation: press on = despite the darkness 表示有明顯阻力，仍繼續救援，故 pressed on 最貼切。
maintained = 可維持 operation，但不能像 pressed on 突出克服黑暗。

exercises.original: Although the route was difficult, they continued until sunset.
exercises.zh: 雖然路線困難，他們仍繼續走到日落。
exercises.upgrade: press on · 繼續前進；堅持做下去

options.explanation: press on = route was difficult 但仍持續前進，pressed on 是有力度而自然的表達。
completed = 未說完成整條路線。

words.note: 表示把某個活動、速度、努力或標準持續維持下去。

exercises.original: You should continue the good work.
exercises.zh: 你應該繼續保持良好表現。
exercises.upgrade: keep up · 繼續保持；維持

options.explanation: repeat = 不是把同一項工作再做一次。
keep up = the good work 是固定搭配，表示維持目前良好表現，因此 keep up 最自然。

exercises.original: The team needs to continue its efforts if it wants to meet the deadline.
exercises.zh: 團隊若要趕及期限，就需要繼續保持努力。
exercises.upgrade: keep up · 繼續保持；維持

options.explanation: repeat = 努力不是重複一次。
keep up = 現有 efforts 必須維持到 deadline，因此 keep up its efforts 很貼切。
remain = 不能說 remain its efforts。

exercises.original: She continued the same pace for the final five kilometres.
exercises.zh: 最後五公里，她繼續保持同樣速度。
exercises.upgrade: keep up · 繼續保持；維持

options.explanation: repeated = pace 不是重複動作。
resumed = 沒有先降速或停下。
keep up = the same pace 是典型維持語境，因此 kept up 最準確。

words.note: 較正式，表示讓某種狀態、水平、活動或條件持續不變。
words.example: The company maintained production throughout the disruption.
words.exampleZh: 公司在受干擾期間仍維持生產。

exercises.original: The factory continued production throughout the power restrictions.
exercises.zh: 工廠在電力限制期間仍維持生產。
exercises.upgrade: maintain · 維持；持續保持

options.explanation: repeated = 不是重新生產同一批。
maintain = throughout the power restrictions 表示讓 production 持續保持，因此 maintained 最精確。
proceeded = 可以說 proceeded with production，但 throughout 更強調維持。

exercises.original: The athlete continued a high level of performance throughout the season.
exercises.zh: 運動員整季都維持高水平表現。
exercises.upgrade: maintain · 維持；持續保持

options.explanation: repeated = 不是重複一次表現。
pressed on = 通常修飾人繼續行動，不直接說 press on a level。
maintain = a high level + throughout the season 明確表示維持某種水平，因此 maintained 最自然。

exercises.original: The company continued regular deliveries during the roadworks.
exercises.zh: 道路工程期間，公司仍維持正常送貨。
exercises.upgrade: maintain · 維持；持續保持

options.explanation: maintain = 道路工程期間仍保持 regular deliveries，maintained 最準確。
repeated = regular deliveries 本來就反覆發生，但重點是沒有因 roadworks 中斷。

words.note: 較正式，表示使某個過程、活動、增長或狀態能夠繼續一段時間。
words.example: The business could not sustain that rate of growth.
words.exampleZh: 企業無法維持那樣的增長速度。

exercises.original: The company cannot continue this level of growth indefinitely.
exercises.zh: 公司無法無限期維持這個增長水平。
exercises.upgrade: sustain · 維持；使持續

options.explanation: proceed = 不能自然說 proceed this level of growth。
sustain = this level of growth indefinitely 強調某種高水平能否長期維持，因此 sustain 最精確。

exercises.original: The organization needs more funding to continue its services over the next five years.
exercises.zh: 機構需要更多資金，才能在未來五年維持服務。
exercises.upgrade: sustain · 維持；使持續

options.explanation: sustain = more funding + over the next five years 表示讓服務長期持續，因此 sustain 最自然。
remain = 不能說 remain its services。

exercises.original: The current level of spending cannot continue for much longer.
exercises.zh: 目前的開支水平無法再持續很久。
exercises.upgrade: sustain · 維持；使持續

options.explanation: be resumed = resume 暗示暫停後再開始，意思不同。
sustain = 這裡問的是某個 spending level 能否長期保持，因此被動 be sustained 最貼切。
be repeated = 不是重複一筆開支。
be finished = 不是說完成水平。

words.note: 當 continue 表示某種狀態沒有改變時，可用 remain。
words.example: The road will remain closed until Monday.
words.exampleZh: 道路將繼續封閉至星期一。

exercises.original: The road will continue to be closed until Monday.
exercises.zh: 道路將繼續封閉至星期一。
exercises.upgrade: remain · 繼續處於；仍然是

options.explanation: remain = continue to be closed 表示狀態不變，因此簡潔用 remain closed 最自然。
resume = 道路不是『恢復封閉』。
proceed = 不能說 road proceed closed。
persist = 可說 closure persists，但不能直接自然替代這個結構。

exercises.original: Prices are expected to continue at roughly the same level.
exercises.zh: 預計價格將繼續維持在大致相同水平。
exercises.upgrade: remain · 繼續處於；仍然是

options.explanation: remain = the same level 表示狀態維持不變，因此 remain 最精確。

exercises.original: The office will continue open during the renovation.
exercises.zh: 裝修期間辦公室將繼續開放。
exercises.upgrade: remain · 繼續處於；仍然是

options.explanation: remain = 裝修期間狀態仍是 open，固定搭配 remain open 最自然。
press on = 主語 office 不適合。

words.note: 表示某件事曾中斷或暫停，之後再次繼續。
words.example: The meeting resumed after a short break.
words.exampleZh: 短暫休息後，會議繼續進行。

exercises.original: The meeting continued after a short break.
exercises.zh: 短暫休息後，會議繼續進行。
exercises.upgrade: resume · 恢復；繼續

options.explanation: persisted = 會議不是問題／症狀持續。
resume = after a short break 明確有中斷，因此重新繼續應用 resumed。
remained = 不能表達停止後重新開始。
repeated = 不是把會議從頭重做。

exercises.original: Flights continued once the fog had cleared.
exercises.zh: 霧散後，航班恢復運作。
exercises.upgrade: resume · 恢復；繼續

options.explanation: persisted = 不是持續存在，因為霧期間很可能停航。
repeated = 不是重飛同一航班。
resume = once the fog had cleared 暗示之前因霧中斷，之後恢復，因此 resumed 最精確。
remained = 不能表達重新運作。
started = 航班服務不是第一次開始。

exercises.original: Work continued the following morning after being suspended overnight.
exercises.zh: 工作夜間暫停後，翌晨繼續。
exercises.upgrade: resume · 恢復；繼續

options.explanation: remained = 不能在 suspended 後表示重新開始。
resume = after being suspended overnight 是最直接的中斷線索，所以 resumed 是唯一最自然的選擇。

words.meaning: 堅持到底；繼續按原計劃走
words.note: 常見慣用語，表示即使遇到困難仍按原方向或計劃繼續。
words.example: The team decided to stay the course despite criticism.
words.exampleZh: 儘管受到批評，團隊仍決定按原計劃堅持下去。

exercises.original: Despite criticism, the team decided to continue with its original plan.
exercises.zh: 儘管受到批評，團隊仍決定按原計劃堅持下去。
exercises.upgrade: stay the course · 堅持到底；繼續按原計劃走

options.explanation: change direction = 和 original plan 相反。
stay the course = despite criticism + original plan 表示面對壓力仍按既定方向前進，因此 stay the course 最貼切。

exercises.original: The government said it would continue with the policy despite short-term difficulties.
exercises.zh: 政府表示即使面對短期困難，也會繼續推行該政策。
exercises.upgrade: stay the course · 堅持到底；繼續按原計劃走

options.explanation: reverse course = 表示改變方向，意思相反。
stay the course = 遇到 short-term difficulties 仍不改政策方向，慣用語 stay the course 很自然。

exercises.original: Investors were nervous, but the company chose to continue with its long-term strategy.
exercises.zh: 投資者感到不安，但公司仍選擇堅持長期策略。
exercises.upgrade: stay the course · 堅持到底；繼續按原計劃走

options.explanation: abandon the strategy = 意思相反。
stay the course = 外界緊張但仍堅持 long-term strategy，stay the course 能準確表達不改方向。

words.note: 較有力度，表示不受阻礙地繼續前進或推動工作。
words.example: The company forged ahead with its expansion plans.
words.exampleZh: 公司繼續積極推進擴展計劃。

exercises.original: The company continued with its expansion plans despite the weak economy.
exercises.zh: 儘管經濟疲弱，公司仍繼續推進擴展計劃。
exercises.upgrade: forge ahead · 繼續向前；積極推進

options.explanation: abandoned = 放棄計劃，意思相反。
forge ahead = despite the weak economy 仍積極推動 expansion，forged ahead 最有力度。
remained = 不能說 remain with plans 來表達積極推進。

exercises.original: The researchers continued with the trial even after several technical problems.
exercises.zh: 即使出現幾個技術問題，研究人員仍繼續推進試驗。
exercises.upgrade: forge ahead · 繼續向前；積極推進

options.explanation: finished = 技術問題後仍在進行，未完成。
repeated = 不是重做整個 trial。
forge ahead = 遇到 technical problems 仍積極向前推進 trial，因此 forged ahead 很貼切。

exercises.original: Construction continued despite opposition from several local groups.
exercises.zh: 儘管受到數個本地團體反對，工程仍繼續推進。
exercises.upgrade: forge ahead · 繼續向前；積極推進

options.explanation: repeated = 工程不是重複一次。
remained = 不能自然表達 construction 的前進。
forge ahead = despite opposition 突出阻力，而工程仍積極向前，因此 forged ahead 最準確。

falseSynonyms.zh: 開始不等於繼續 start 表示某件事剛開始；continue 表示已開始後仍然進行。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The class starts at nine and continues until noon.

falseSynonyms.zh: 重複不等於繼續 repeat 是把同一件事重新做一次；continue 是不中斷地做下去。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He repeated the question, then continued speaking.

falseSynonyms.zh: 重新開始不等於不中斷地繼續 restart 表示停止後再開始；只有在有中斷時才接近 resume。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The machine stopped and then restarted. Production later continued normally.

falseSynonyms.zh: 完成不等於繼續 finish 表示事情結束，和 continue 的方向相反。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She continued working until she finished the report.

falseSynonyms.zh: 暫停不等於繼續 pause 表示短暫停止。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The speaker paused briefly and then continued.

falseSynonyms.zh: 動詞與名詞不同 continue 是動詞；continuation 是名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON They will continue the project. Its continuation depends on funding.

falseSynonyms.zh: 形容詞與動詞不同 continuous 表示連續不斷的；continue 是動詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON There was continuous rain. The rain continued all day.

falseSynonyms.zh: 反覆發生與連續不斷不同 continual 常表示反覆發生；continuous 表示沒有中斷。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON There were continual interruptions, but the machine ran continuously.
